title: Easy Improvements for your Resume Bullets ✍️
description:
Resume bullets NEED to show impact if you want to land interviews and just listing a task you did at a job doesn't hold any. For a great resume achievement you need to include the following steps...

1. What did you do? (Company impact) 
2. What metric did you improve and in what time span? (NUMBERS)
3. Connect your action to strategy (Include job description hard skills)

A hiring manager wants to see your value as an employee so add skills and results to every achievement for higher chances of landing that interview.
